<?php
class Argument191 { public string $tag = 'old'; public function __destruct() { echo 'ARG(', $this->tag, ');'; } }
function clear191() { global $owner, $argument; $owner = null; $argument = 99; echo 'CLEAR;'; return new Argument191; }
class CallBase191 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo 'MAGIC;'; return new class($arguments[1], $name . ':' . $arguments[0] . ':' . self::class . ':' . static::class . ':' . self::secret() . ':' . __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public $argument, public string $data) { echo 'CHILD;'; } public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP-CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class CallDerived191 extends CallBase191 {}
$owner = new CallDerived191; $argument = 7; $child = $owner->MiSsInG($argument, clear191()); echo 'RETURN;', $argument, ':'; echo $child->argument->tag, ':', $child->data, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';

class StaticBase191 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments) { echo 'MAGIC;'; return new class($arguments[1], $name . ':' . $arguments[0] . ':' . self::class . ':' . static::class . ':' . self::secret() . ':' . __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public $argument, public string $data) { echo 'CHILD;'; } public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP-CHILD;'; } }; } }
class StaticDerived191 extends StaticBase191 {}
$argument = 7; $child = StaticDerived191::MiSsInG($argument, staticClear191()); echo 'RETURN;', $argument, ':'; echo $child->argument->tag, ':', $child->data, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($name, __METHOD__, $arguments) { public function __construct(public string $name, public string $method, public array $arguments) {} }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } };
$child = $owner->MiSsInG(7); unset($owner); $after = new class {}; echo $child->name, ':', $child->method, ':', $child->arguments[0], ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';
